name: Disable Samsung telemetry, ACR, voice and account services
description: 1.4.0 stops masking data-service: measured on a QN65S90FAGXZB by press-bisect, masking it makes the remote's volume keys stall 2-3s (one press = two steps at an eARC AVR) because the unit is Type=dbus BusName=org.tizen.tv.logger and org.tizen.tv.logger plus org.tizen.tv.dataservice both activate it, so callers on the input path wait for a name that can never appear. It unmasks data-service and its two busname units on apply, so an upgrade heals without a reboot. 1.3.0 added five units found running and unmasked on that audit: the diagnostics pair (issue_report_agent, abnormal_user_behavior), media-analytics-service, and the far-field-voice and voiceid services (both also given their vendor opt-out switch), plus pushd.socket and farfieldvoice.path. Masks pushd/bms/appbinary-manager units, plants vendor opt-out switches, kills the ACR service app, Bixby/voice stack, SSO and CIS processes at every boot, and supervises a 30s watchdog. Disable via the manager or the disabled flag; revival needs a reboot.
author: levkropp
